title: core/router.js: one numbering of history entries, the trail, back links and layers
change: Rewrite core/router.js as in the prototype (w1/place2/fin/core/router.js). (1) Pure, exported: stampOf(state, prev, fresh) -> {v, n, kind}; splitHref(href) -> {path, q}; backSteps(trail, n, href, {max}) -> steps or 0. Rules: the nearest earlier entry with the link's page and query; 'from' ignored; a 'month' the entry lacks matches; more than one step only while every entry in between has the same q.from as this one. (2) router.start(onChange): on each hashchange, clear open layers; stamp a new entry with history.replaceState({...state, v, n}); a state with v and n is a return. Update sessionStorage planner.trail(.sandbox) = {v, first, items{n:{p,q}}}, deleting items >= n for a new entry and keeping at most 60. Call onChange(route, router.entry()). (3) router.entry() -> {v, n, kind, key: v.n, first}; router.first(); router.at(n) -> {p, q}; router.back(href) -> history.go(-steps) and true, or false. (4) router.layer(close): pushState({...state, layer: id}) at the same address, returning release(). popstate with a layer open calls the newest close(); release() steps off its entry when on top; an entry for a layer no longer open is stepped off. Every write spreads history.state (Get started's suFrom survives). (5) core/app.js: makeCtx gives ctx.layer = (close) => router.layer(close). No behaviour change on screen yet.

title: One wrapper of the scroll calls (counting the page's own scrolls) and overflow-anchor: none
change: core/place.js exports wrapScroll(obj, name, hook): it replaces obj[name] with a function that calls hook(name, args, this) and then the original with the same this, arguments and return value. core/app.js installs it once at boot on window (scrollTo, scrollBy, scroll) and Element.prototype (scrollIntoView, scrollTo, scrollBy, focus), with place's hook. The hook counts calls while a page draws (drawingNow > 0, set around m.render). Taps adds its reduced-motion hook to the same wrapper in its step 6; there is no second wrapper. base.css (shell selector): html { overflow-anchor: none } so Chromium behaves like Safari.

title: Back, Forward and Reload come back where the person was, with the same sections open
change: createPlace({sandbox, topbar, onParked}). It keeps sessionStorage planner.place(.sandbox): entry key -> {path, y, docH, anchor chain from topThing, folds, at}, newest 40, with its own key and format version. init() sets history.scrollRestoration = 'manual' and listens for pointerdown, touchstart, wheel and keydown (marks that end a hold), clicks on summaries (touched folds), and visibilitychange hidden and pagehide (save). show() for a new address: place.leave() + cancelHold() + remove .save-echo, then cleanup(), then place.arrive(router.entry()). A record is used only when kind is 'return' and no #sync-bar exists. scrollTo(rec ? rec.y : 0) and minHeight = max(y + innerHeight, docH) - offsetTop happen before the render. After the render: apply the record's folds, then holdPlace(chain, {fallbackY, landOn, topbar, alive: routeSeq, room, done}). The hold runs every frame up to 8 s and stops 700 ms after nothing moves, at a touch, wheel or key, at another address, or at planner:reveal (boot listener: cancelHold). Room is released as soon as a link of the chain is drawn; when only a landmark is drawn, it (or landOn) comes to the top. showConflict() calls cancelHold() before scrollTo(0, 0). A record is written only after the page finished drawing. Keep the prototype's ?place=off switch until P9 for before/after runs.

title: Typing not saved survives leaving, coming back, a reload and a stray tap, and never goes into another row's form
change: Drafts are kept in sessionStorage planner.drafts(.sandbox): page path -> {at, items[{k, tag, v, d, f, form, host, parked?}]}, separate from places, with a format version. A page's typing over 20 KB is not kept, and typing older than 24 h is dropped at boot. Typed = a trusted input or change on a keepable control (not a password or a box named or labelled token, API key, secret, password, pass code, PIN, not inside [data-no-keep]). At the first input the box records where.path (the page it was typed on) and its locator. Drafts are saved 0.5 s after typing, on leave, on hidden and on pagehide, each filed under where.path; parked items are kept. They are dropped on submit of their form, for the boxes a tapped button used when its task saved (usedBy: its form or card), when the tap that saved also leaves the page (no newer input within 1.5 s: its own form's boxes and every box in no form), on 'Undo my typing' and 'Throw it away', and on Cancel. On every draw: apply drafts by the same-form rule, park the rest, and draw the line '.notice.info.place-parked' at the host; when the line is unseen, show an info copy. The MutationObserver on #content ignores everything while the shell is busy and before the page is drawn (busy/idle with takeRecords). It parks typed boxes the page removes (not by their Cancel, not the sent form) under their own path and refills them when the same form reappears (quietly in the same moment, else onParked -> info copy naming the form's heading). It restores folds a page's own redraw took away within 2 s.

Each fresh notice (not [data-moved]) gets its own remove() that only removes inside a trusted event (window.event?.isTrusted). The bottom copy is decided one frame later (requestAnimationFrame then setTimeout 0; skipped if renderSeq moved): when no fresh notice is seen, echo(words, ok|bad, ways, tappedRect). ways = [the notice's button.notice-action, else its first link or button; the root's a[data-back]] as 44 px .save-echo-go taps (a link keeps data-back; a button proxies a click). echo(): kinds ok, bad and info (info has no tick); .at-top when overlaps(copy, tapped control); it stays echoStay(text, ways, bad); it is removed on an address change and when its back link is tapped. title: Docs, clean-up and hand-offs
change: Remove the measuring switches: ?place=off, window.__place, __placeLast, and any anchor or keep switch. CONVENTIONS gets 'What the shell keeps for you': open sections, typing not saved, focus, the place on Back, Forward and Reload. Pages do not build their own draft or place keeping; notices need no removal timer; an edit form opened over the page calls ctx.layer(close) and release(); back links carry data-back; give boxes a name and a visible label, and put a form's heading above it inside its card. DESIGN_LOG gets the six choices made without asking the owner (final.md section 7). CHANGELOG gets one line per step. The WORKBOARD message hands the touch rules (D-DRAFT, D-OTHER-FORM, D-FOLD-KEPT, D-STILL, D-ROW-SWAP, D-NO-PHANTOM, strict D-BACK, the D-TOP exemption for a[data-back] and .save-echo a) to the sweep's owner; the ctx.layer adoption list to the page lanes (claude-g, claude-h, claude-d; goals/travel to claude-a's handoff file); the timer deletion and the W4 and RB1 page parts to claude-b's wave 2 follow-up.
